_form_note: Verified against the production push workflow ('push_api_production18') in the .ds export -- confidence is high. Same pattern as Applicants_Basic_Details: institutionCode is hardcoded to 141 in the push script regardless of the Institutional_Codes field's value.

fields._note: Raw HEDB code is converted to its descriptive Name using the 'Institutional Codes' reference list. Not used by the actual API push (institutionCode is hardcoded to 141) -- only populates the Zoho record for display.

HEDB carries this as a separate free-text column, but the Zoho form only has one institution field (Institutional_Codes, a picklist driven by App_Institution_Code). Redundant with the code lookup above -- intentionally not imported separately.
Raw HEDB code is converted to a combined 'Name - Code' display value using the 'Academic Period' reference list (matches the form's displayformat = [Name + " - " + Code]).

Raw HEDB code is converted to its descriptive Name using the 'Degree or Program Level' reference list. Unlike Applicants_Basic_Details, this form's picklist is NOT filtered to a fixed code subset (values = Degree_Program_Level.ID with no [Code == ...] filter), so any valid degree code should resolve here.

Raw HEDB code is converted to its descriptive Name using the 'Area of Specialization' reference list. HEDB notes '99' should be used if the specialization isn't listed -- make sure code 99 exists in your Zoho Area_of_Specialization lookup form.
Raw HEDB test code is converted to its descriptive Name using the 'Acad Proficiency Test' reference list.

No conversion applied -- value is imported exactly as provided in the raw file. HEDB note: for programs/specializations where no test is required, use test code 13 and score 0 rather than leaving this blank.
Date-time values are trimmed to a plain date (time portion removed) and written as yyyy-mm-dd.
